topics.label: PAEAS / climate-disinformation call · 2026
topics.description: Fundación Biodiversidad competitive national call for scientific knowledge, innovation and evidence in environmental education and climate-disinformation research under PAEAS 2026–2032. Line A concerns environmental education; Line B climate disinformation. Total €7m, €3.5m per line; up to €200,000 requested grant per project and 80% of eligible project cost. The call states 10 November 2026 inclusive as the application date limit; exact cutoff time/timezone is unverified. This dated call is a preparation lead for a suitable established organisation, not a personal planting subsidy or a confirmed award. Applicant identity, land access and readiness for Algarrobos remain unconfirmed.

source_refs.label: Grant cap, rate and execution period

aspects.research_classification: Prepare; conditional urgency only for an already eligible organisation with a ready proposal

topics.label: Line A · environmental education
topics.description: Supports evidence-building environmental education under PAEAS 2026–2032. Applicant classes: Spanish registered nonprofit legal entities, public research organisations, public universities and professional colleges. Activities can include evaluation of educational effectiveness, citizen-science learning and nature-based educational climate refuges. An ordinary company, individual, municipality or generic restoration project is not thereby an eligible applicant; verify the exact institutional category and governing bases.

topics.label: Line B · climate-disinformation research
topics.description: Multidisciplinary research on climate disinformation and its educational/social response. Restricted by this call to public research organisations and public universities, unlike Line A. No presumed nonprofit or business route.

source_refs.label: Line B: public research and universities

topics.label: PAEAS · assessment and selection gates
topics.description: Specific criteria total 50: technical 20, economic 5, environmental/social 25. Strategic criteria total 50. The strategic score must exceed 25; 25 exactly does not pass this additional call gate. The general thresholds and tie-breakers also depend on article 17 of the governing bases, not fully reviewed here. This is a source rule, not an executable or calculated project score; provisional proposals confer no award right.

source_refs.label: Specific scoring table and provisional award limitation

topics.label: PAEAS · eligible costs and cash flow
topics.description: Maximum grant 80% of eligible project cost and €200,000; the remainder must be financed. Main payment follows justification. An advance up to 50% of the awarded grant may be requested; guarantee rules have exemptions, including qualifying nonprofits carrying out environmental programmes. Indirect costs capped at 10% of direct costs. Depreciation/rental may qualify; direct purchase, construction, rehabilitation or improvement of inventoriable assets and land/property purchase are excluded. Recoverable VAT is excluded. Justify the entire project cost, not only the subsidy, within two months of project completion. Exact cost eligibility and guarantee status need institutional review.

topics.label: PAEAS · complete and signed submission
topics.description: One proposal per entity per line, with specific official logical-framework, budget, human-resources and schedule templates. Missing/incomplete core templates can be non-remediable. The guide warns that the form does not save drafts or resume sessions. Final signing submits automatically; obtain and preserve the receipt. The guide is procedural support; its article numbering does not override the actual call. No application was submitted by this intake.

topics.description: Transnational biodiversity-research partnership. Its individual calls and each participating funder’s national rules determine access; a programme overview does not establish an open grant.

topics.label: BiodivFuture · Call 2026–2027
topics.description: Research call on novel ecosystems and resilient futures, not a general implementation grant for restoring a private site. Themes A ecosystem functioning, B pathways and C benefits/equity. Supports research, experimentation, pilots and evaluation; intensive simplified production systems themselves are outside the stated scope. Mandatory preproposal 10 November 2026 12:00 CET; invited full proposals 16 April 2027 12:00 CEST. At least three eligible partners from three participating countries and three funding organisations, including two EU/associated countries. No prepared consortium is confirmed. The Spanish gate must be checked before thematic fit is promoted.

topics.label: BiodivFuture · Spain AEI / FB conditions
topics.description: V6 national rules, 4 November 2026: AEI covers all environments but Spanish AEI-funded groups may participate only in proposals addressing A/B; Theme C is excluded even when combined with A/B. FB covers marine/coastal environments on A/B/C, so an inland dryland proposal cannot assume FB funding. Beneficiaries are nonprofit research organisations in Spain with previous AEI competitive funding, subject to national PCI/PI rules. One AEI/FB applicant per proposal; two only if one coordinates. National application is due within one week after preproposal submission. Late addition at stage two is normally not allowed, with a narrow low-participation exception requiring funder confirmation. Exact budget-cap graphic and underlying PCI documents remain pending.

topics.label: Water4All
topics.description: Research and innovation partnership pooling national funding for water security under Horizon Europe. Its joint calls seek transferable knowledge and solutions, with national funding rules; it is distinct from water-authority procurement or a standing parcel-restoration grant.

topics.label: Water4All · Sustainable Water Management 2026
topics.description: Joint transnational R&I call. Topic 2 explicitly includes nature-based groundwater, retention, infiltration and river-basin restoration at catchment scale; demonstration is welcomed. Other topics concern integrated monitoring, smart infrastructure and governance. Mandatory preproposal 10 November 2026 15:00 CET; full stage 6 April 2027 15:00 CEST is for invited entrants and remains timetable-dependent. Minimum three funded partners/three countries and two independent EU/associated-country recipients. General maximum seven partners including at most one self-funded; the call allows eight if an undersubscribed-funder partner is included. Duration 36 months. No eligible applicant or ready consortium is confirmed for Algarrobos.

topics.label: Water4All · Spain AEI research route
topics.description: Spanish nonprofit research organisations, with prior AEI competitive funding at least once since 2015, subject to PCI and PI requirements. Main topic must be 2, 3 or 4 and Spanish activities only those topics. Other partners may address Topic 1 to a minor extent, no more than 30% of total content; the Spanish AEI group must not support those Topic 1 activities. One AEI applicant per proposal, or two if one coordinates. National AEI application within one week of preproposal submission; failing it breaches eligibility. Exact cap graphics and linked PCI rules still require review.

topics.label: Water4All · Spain CDTI company grant route
topics.description: Call-specific route for for-profit companies established and conducting R&D in Spain; universities and nonprofits are not eligible for this funder. Topics 1–4, regular JTC only (not ECR). Technology-based industrial research/experimental development at TRL4–7 implemented in Spain; nontechnological business-model activities excluded. Minimum financeable budget €150,000 (about €200,000 advised). CDTI finances up to 70% through grants; this differs from its general partially repayable PID instrument. Company must also apply through CDTI by the same end date as the international first phase; missing that national process makes it ineligible. National funding commitment €400,000 is a call allocation, not an individual cap. Exact state-aid rate and applicant fit remain subject to CDTI review.

topics.label: Interreg Euro-MED
topics.description: Mediterranean transnational cooperation programme. The dated thematic call below has specific partnership, public-lead and territorial readiness requirements; geography alone is not evidence of an award or a responsible provincial intermediary.

topics.label: Euro-MED Call 8 · thematic Test projects
topics.description: Territorial-resilience pilot call: total allocation about €20m (€16m Interreg plus €4m national co-financing), maximum total project budget €2m and maximum 24 months with no duration extension. Written application due 13 November 2026 13:00 Brussels time (CET); mandatory annexes due 27 November 2026 13:00 Brussels time. Fixed activities 1 June 2027–31 May 2029 include closure. These amounts are total budgets, not a €2m individual grant promise. Only a mature partnership could realistically use this call; none is confirmed for this project.

topics.label: Euro-MED Call 8 · consortium and site readiness
topics.description: At least five countries within the cooperation area. Lead must be a public body or body governed by public law; partners need competence and implementation capacity. Pilot partners need land/facility ownership or agreement. Associated partners do not count toward the minimum partnership. Annexes require signed declarations, relevant landowner agreement and a feasible procurement calendar; investments bring additional obligations. Programme manual, territorial details, partner rates and payment timing require further review before an eligibility or cash-flow decision.

findings.label: Advance guarantees have exemptions
findings.text: The scan’s shorthand “advance with guarantee” omitted the exemptions expressly retained in article 14.7, including nonprofits carrying out environmental programmes. The accepted knowledge records the conditional exemption, not a universal guarantee requirement or a finding that this user qualifies.

findings.label: BiodivFuture · FB payment differs from general AEI route
findings.text: The FB column states payment on completion, possible 40% advance before the mid-term report (a guarantee may be necessary), and default project start 1 April 2028. These conditions apply to that funding route, not automatically to AEI or the separate PAEAS call.

findings.label: Research fit concerns catchment-scale evidence
findings.text: Topic 2 welcomes demonstration and explicitly seeks evidence about both benefits and negative impacts of nature-based measures on recharge, infiltration, retention, groundwater quality and river basins. A small dryland site could only be a conditional research contribution within a suitable consortium; the call does not establish effectiveness of any local water-harvesting method.
